title: Working Student (f/m/d) – Product Management for SAP Business AI
description: Job Description What you’ll bring You're a student ready to contribute alongside your studies. You're curious, adapt quickly, and stay resilient as priorities evolve. You think creatively, communicate clearly, and collaborate well across teams. You're building your foundations in business and AI — and you take initiative to apply them. You bring emotional intelligence and cultural awareness to every interaction. You are enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences, preferably in a master’s programme in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering and Management, Media Informatics, Information Systems or a related field combining business and technology Previous working-student or internship experience in product management, product owner support or technical project coordination is an advantage. Relevant university or personal projects can also demonstrate your skills You have a basic understanding of generative AI, large language models and AI agents, and practical experience using AI assistants for research, summaries or analysis. You can refine prompts, check results against sources and recognize when human review is needed You bring basic programming or scripting skills, preferably Python, and an interest in building small automations for tasks such as collecting project updates or preparing reports. Experience with Git, APIs or AI-assisted prototypes is an advantage You organize information, identify gaps and dependencies, and follow up on agreed actions. You write clear summaries for technical and business audiences. You can explain a workflow, write a short guide and gather feedback to understand whether a tool helps its users Your English is at B2 level or higher, written and spoken; German is an advantage. You can work from our Potsdam office once a week on Wednesdays What You’ll Build You'll work on real deliverables, not shadow tasks. Your contributions connect directly to your team's goals. You'll leave with a portfolio of SAP work you can build on. In this role, you will support product management in AI Foundation and develop AI tools for planning, research and reporting. Collect input from engineers, architects and other stakeholders. Structure requirements and open questions so the team can prepare decisions and agree next steps Support Product Owners with backlog refinement and quarterly planning. Keep milestones, dependencies and progress visible so teams can identify gaps and coordinate delivery Prepare meetings, workshops and stakeholder updates. Record decisions and follow up with owners so agreed actions move forward Help improve our internal AI assistant and automate tasks such as collecting project updates and drafting reports. With support from the team, test these tools and check that their results accurately reflect the source information Gather feedback through surveys and conversations. Write short guides and help colleagues adopt tools and ways of working that meet their needs Where you belong As a working student you will be part of SAP Next Gen, a global network of students and early professionals growing together. You'll access mentors, development programmes, and peers building careers alongside you. It's a place to start something real. At SAP, AI Foundation develops and operates technology and services that help teams and customers use AI in business applications. Our Central Engineering Services team works across product and engineering teams for AI platform of SAP. We explore technical solutions, build prototypes and help improve software delivery and reliability. Our product management work connects stakeholder needs with technical options and team priorities. You will work closely with product management colleagues, engineers and architects, combining planning and coordination with practical AI tooling. Additional Information Please apply initially with your resume in table form. In a later stage we will ask you to upload also school leaving certificates, certificate of enrollment, current university transcript of records, copies of any academic degrees already earned, and if available, references from former employers (including internships). This is a SAP global, strategic, paid working student position that provides students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. #Workingstudent #Werkstudent #Germany #Deutschland #Student #SAPGermanStudentsCareers #SAPNextGen About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements. AI Usage in the Recruitment Process For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process. Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

cover_letter_paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Working Student (f/m/d) – Product Management for SAP Business AI role at SAP. With a Bachelor’s in Digital Product Management, ongoing Master’s studies in International Business Management in Berlin, and over two years of hands-on experience at AUTO1 Group scaling AI operations, data reporting, and internal tooling, I combine analytical rigor with proactive builder execution to deliver immediate value to your team.

In my role as Junior Project Manager at AUTO1 Group in Berlin (since 2024, progressing from Intern to Working Student), I collaborate daily across Product, Engineering, and Operations teams in 9 European markets. I helped drive the end-to-end rollout and continuous optimization of our AI voice bot (routing millions of calls, increasing inbound answer rates by over 80%, and lifting call-to-booking conversion by over 50%), while shipping a suite of production internal tools and workflow automations. I partnered closely with product managers and engineers to scope features, define user requirements, and roll out production web tools and AI knowledge bases across 9 European markets.

Beyond daily operations, I thrive on untangling disorganized data and turning operational friction into clean, repeatable processes. I write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau, and Excel to provide reliable metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I prototype lightweight internal tools using JavaScript and REST APIs. Working in an international Berlin environment, I communicate fluently in English (C1/C2) and Spanish (native), with working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about SAP is the opportunity to bring this blend of product operations discipline, SQL analytics, and builder execution to your team in the Working Student (f/m/d) – Product Management for SAP Business AI role. Thank you for your time and consideration—I look forward to discussing how I can contribute in an interview.

title: Project Management - Project Intern (GBS) - 2027 Start
description: Responsibilities TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results. Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last. You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners. As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities Support the Head of SCS with operational execution, prioritization, and follow-through across EUI Support SCS programs & priorties by coordinating inputs, timelines, and dependencies Support operational cadence, including planning cycles, milestones, reviews, and progress tracking against agreed priorities Track program KPIs, risks, and actions, ensuring visibility and follow-through Support the standardization of processes, tooling, and documentation to scale SCS ways of working Identify process simplification, automation, and efficiency opportunities to reduce operational friction Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor's in business, management or a related discipline and available for a 6-month internship Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively Proactive, reliable, and quick to learn, with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment Strong analytical and structured thinking skills with good data sense Excellent written and verbal communication skills Comfortable working with presentations, spreadsheets, trackers, and project documentation Preferred Qualifications Previous internship or experience in project coordination, operations, business support, or a similar role Understanding of media planning across platforms Job Information About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. Diversity & Inclusion TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Procurement Data, Analytics & Digital Solutions
description: Location: BLN P 26 Department: SE GT SG P CVE A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic Cost Value Engineering (CVE) procurement team at Siemens Energy Grid Technologies as a part-time working student, where you will play a crucial role in driving digital transformation and enhancing procurement efficiency. You will engage in data landscape analysis, evaluate AI and analytics use cases, and support the optimization of digital tools, particularly within the Microsoft Power Platform. Your contributions will empower the procurement department to make informed, data-driven decisions and streamline workflows, all while gaining valuable experience in a collaborative environment. How You’ll Make An Impact Analysis of existing data sources within Procurement and CVE to identify requirements for current and future business processes Documentation of data structures, flows, and responsibilities to support the development of a robust data governance framework Assessment of data quality, identification of improvement opportunities, and preparation of analyses, reports, and management presentations Exploration of AI and analytics use cases, with a focus on price forecasting and supplier analytics to support data-driven decision-making Support in the operation and enhancement of Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate solutions to ensure alignment with evolving business needs What You Bring Enrollment in a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree program in Business Information Systems, Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field Initial experience or strong interest in data analytics, database management, and Power Platform applications gained through university projects or internships Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or Python as a significant advantage Very good professional German and good English language skills for effective communication in a diverse environment About The Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Exciting insights into an international company Lay the foundation for your career with us We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO

title: Network Development Analyst (Werkstudent m/w/d)
description: Job Description This is Allego Allego provides reliable charging solutions to cities, companies, and consumers. We deliver charging facilities that can be used by all electric cars and every EV driver, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero emission mobility and see to it that EV drivers can charge at the right location with the right solution. The EV market is growing and changing rapidly. The road is exciting and with confidence we stay ahead. A Bit More About The Job We are looking for a new team member to join our Network Planning team, which is located in Berlin (DE). The Network Planning team is responsible for determining the right location for the right type of charger to support investment decisions for infrastructure expansion and to reach our goal of clean mobility. In other words: as a Network Development Analyst you help us spot locations where people with EVs are, or potentially would like to charge, based on lots of data. You also support with development of our proprietary Network planning tools. With your analyses you play a pivot role in the investment decisions for expansion of our network. Of course you won’t do this alone. You will be a part of a dynamic international team. They will help you to get up to speed within Allego, but hopefully you can teach them a thing or two yourself, because a fresh pair of eyes always sees new things. The Network Planning team collaborates closely with related departments within Allego like Sales, Finance and Product Development. So you will operate in an international environment with colleagues from all over Europe. Since Allego is one of the main players in this new and growing industry, you will be able to shape the future of transport and build the charging infrastructure of the future! title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) - Agile Project Support within SAP Store
description: Wir helfen die Welt zu verbessern Bei SAP halten wir es einfach: Du bringst dein Bestes mit, und wir holen das Beste aus dir heraus. Wir sind Macher, die über 20 Branchen und 80 % des weltweiten Handels beeinflussen – und wir brauchen deine einzigartigen Talente, um die Zukunft mitzugestalten. Die Arbeit ist herausfordernd – aber sie zählt. Du findest bei uns einen Ort, an dem du du selbst sein kannst, dein Wohlbefinden an erster Stelle steht und du wirklich dazugehört. Was hast du davon? Ständiges Lernen, Weiterentwicklung deiner Fähigkeiten, großartige Zusatzleistungen und ein Team, das möchte, dass du wächst und erfolgreich bist. Was du mitgestaltest Scrum-Master-Tätigkeiten: Unterstützung bei der Implementierung und Sicherstellung agiler Prozesse über verschiedene Teams hinweg. Moderation der Stakeholder-Kommunikation, Koordination der Teams sowie Gewährleistung der Einhaltung agiler Methoden innerhalb sämtlicher Teamstrukturen Test & Dokumentation: Durchführung von Funktionstests neuer Features mit systematischer Erfassung und Dokumentation von Fehlern in Tracking-Systemen sowie Erstellung aussagekräftiger Testprotokolle und Bug-Reports Go-Live-Management: Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Go-Live-Aktivitäten zur Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Übergangs in den Produktivbetrieb. Steuerung der Kommunikation sowie Umsetzung aller go-live-relevanten Maßnahmen Prozessoptimierung: Analyse und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit Schwerpunkt auf Defect-Management, Go-Live-Orchestrierung sowie der Identifikation weiterer Verbesserungspotenziale zur Steigerung der operativen Effizienz Was du mitbringst Aktuell immatrikuliert in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationstechnologie, Business Administration oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Ausgeprägte Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten mit nachweislicher Fähigkeit, komplexe Projekte zu strukturieren, Prioritäten effizient zu setzen sowie detaillierte Dokumentationen und Zeitpläne zu erstellen und zu pflegen Stark ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles und analytisches Denkvermögen mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Problemstellungen zu analysieren, Ursachen zu identifizieren und strategische Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln Lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessineffizienzen zu erkennen und praxisnahe Optimierungsmaßnahmen abzuleiten Kenntnisse agiler Methoden sowie ein gutes Verständnis des Scrum-Frameworks und der Umsetzung agiler Prozesse Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook Praktische Erfahrungen mit Softwareentwicklung / Programmierung (z. B. Java, Python, C++) sowie Atlassian-Tools (JIRA, Confluence) sind von Vorteil Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse Die regelmäßige Arbeit am Standort Berlin ist erforderlich Wo du hingehörst Deal Execution steuert den gesamten „Opportunity-to-Close“-Prozess – von der Angebotserstellung und Deal-Freigabe bis hin zu Vertragsabschluss und Fulfillment. Durch die Anwendung von Prinzipien des Next-Generation Cloud Selling optimiert das Team nicht nur Prozesse, sondern beschleunigt auch Vertragsabschlüsse und steigert die Erfolgsquoten signifikant, wodurch das Umsatzwachstum von SAP nachhaltig gefördert wird. Mit einem klaren Fokus auf Präzision und Effizienz verantwortet Deal Execution zentrale Prozesse wie Deal-Qualifizierung, Preisgestaltung, Vertragsmanagement sowie die Abwicklung von Verlängerungen und stellt dabei eine fristgerechte Umsatzrealisierung sowie die Einhaltung der IFRS15-Standards sicher. Das E-Commerce Platforms Team als Teil von Deal Execution verantwortet das technische Design sowie die Implementierung sämtlicher Features und Funktionalitäten innerhalb unserer digitalen Commerce-Plattformen. Anwendungen wie der SAP Store (www.sap.com/store) und der Partner Store tragen gemeinsam zur digitalen Distribution umfassender Softwarelösungen bei und ermöglichen einen nahtlosen Zugang zu unseren Angeboten über unterschiedliche Kundensegmente und Märkte hinweg. Unsere Stores dienen als Online-Vertriebskanäle, über die Kunden SAP- und Partnerlösungen aus den Bereichen Application Cloud, Analytics, Datenbanken und Technologieportfolios in einem einfachen Click-through-Prozess erwerben können. Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen sollten neben einem Anschreiben, tabellarischen Lebenslauf, aktuellen Notenspiegel und gültiger Immatrikulationsbescheinigung auch Kopien von Zwischen-, Schulabschluss- und, soweit vorhanden, Arbeitszeugnissen (Praktika) als Anlagen enthalten. Bitte beschreibe außerdem deine Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse in Fremdsprachen und Computerprogrammen/Programmiersprachen. Dies ist eine globale, strategische und bezahlte Werkstudentenstelle, die Studenten und Studentinnen die Möglichkeit bietet, sich beruflich zu orientieren. #Workingstudent #Werkstudent #Germany #Deutschland #Student #SAPGermanStudentsCareers #SAPNextGen Gib dein Bestes SAP-Innovationen helfen mehr als vierhunderttausend Kunden weltweit, effizienter zusammenzuarbeiten und Business Insight effektiver zu nutzen. SAP war ursprünglich für seine Führungsrolle in der ERP-Software (Enterprise Resource Planning) bekannt und hat sich zu einem Marktführer für End-to-End-Software für Geschäftsanwendungen und zugehörige Services für Datenbank, Analyse, intelligente Technologien und Erfahrungsmanagement entwickelt. Als Cloud-Unternehmen mit zweihundert Millionen Benutzern und mehr als einhunderttausend Mitarbeitern weltweit sind wir zielgerichtet und zukunftsorientiert, mit einer äußerst kollaborativen Teamethik und Engagement für die persönliche Entwicklung. Unabhängig davon, ob wir globale Branchen, Menschen oder Plattformen miteinander verbinden, stellen wir sicher, dass jede Herausforderung die Lösung erhält, die sie verdient. Bei SAP kannst du dein Bestes geben. Wir gewinnen durch Inklusion SAPs Kultur der Inklusion, der Fokus auf Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden sowie flexible Arbeitsmodelle stellen sicher, dass sich alle – unabhängig vom Hintergrund – einbezogen fühlt und ihr Bestes geben können. Bei SAP sind wir überzeugt davon, dass uns die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften, die jede Person mitbringt, stärker machen. Deshalb investieren wir in die Menschen bei SAP, um Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und allen zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Unser Ziel ist es, alle Talente zu fördern und eine bessere Welt zu schaffen. Chancengleichheit und Barrierefreiheit SAP bekennt sich zu den Werten der Chancengleichheit am Arbeitsplatz und bietet im Fall von mit körperlichen und/oder geistigen Beeinträchtigungen barrierefreie Unterstützung bei der Bewerbung. Wenn du dich für eine Stelle bei SAP bewerben möchtest und Unterstützung oder besondere Hilfe beim Navigieren auf unserer Website oder beim Ausfüllen deiner Bewerbung benötigst, sende bitte eine E-Mail mit deiner Anfrage an das Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. Anfragen auf angemessene Vorkehrungen werden im Einzelfall geprüft. Nur unbefristete Positionen sind gemäß den Teilnahmebedingungen in der SAP Referral Policy für das SAP-Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm berechtigt. Für Positionen in der Berufsausbildung können besondere Bedingungen gelten. Einsatz von KI im Rekrutierungsprozess Weitere Informationen über den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von KI in unserem Rekrutierungsprozess findest du in unseren Richtlinien zur ethischen Nutzung von KI im Rekrutierungsprozess. Bitte beachte, dass Verstöße gegen diese Richtlinien zum Ausschluss aus dem Bewerbungsprozess führen können. title: Launch Intern (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a **mission to make investing as easy as spending money**. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by **€280M in total funding** from world class investors, including **BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive**. Our latest **€105M funding round in March 2026** led by Sapphire and Tencent serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

Are you ready to kick-start your career at the intersection of fintech and innovation? Join **Upvest** as a **Launch Intern** and help onboard some of Europe’s leading fintechs and financial institutions to our cutting-edge Investment API. This is a dynamic, hands-on opportunity to learn, grow, and make an impact while working alongside a team of experts shaping the future of investment infrastructure.

**What you’ll do:**
===================

* **Assist in Client Onboarding:** Support client launches by collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation from signed contract to go-live. You’ll get hands-on experience with project planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication.
* **Learn 360° Project Management:** Gain exposure to how complex onboarding projects come together in a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll build a solid understanding of technology infrastructure, operational workflows, and regulatory requirements, while contributing to scalable, high-quality client launch experiences.
* **Support Client Collaboration:** Work closely with clients to understand their needs and provide support during their onboarding journey. You’ll learn how to build strong professional relationships and deliver impactful solutions.
* **Develop Best Practices:** Help standardize processes, create reusable documentation, and identify areas for optimization, all while contributing to a faster and more efficient client experience.
* **Improve Workstreams with AI:** Apply your AI expertise to improve and automate onboarding workstreams, and independently drive them to concrete, measurable outcomes.

**What we Are Looking For:**
============================

* A motivated student pursuing a degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with a passion for problem-solving.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for fintech and financial services.
* Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus!) and the ability to collaborate in a team environment.
* Basic knowledge of financial markets or APIs is a bonus but not required.

**What you bring:**
===================

* You worked in a fast-paced environment before (e.g., strategy consulting, venture capital, start-ups).
* You are structured, have very good analytical skills, and know how to solve problems by yourself, allowing you to take ownership and execute projects quickly.
* You are hungry to learn, passionate about the Fintech industry, and want to change the investment world to enable more people to invest.
* You have deep knowledge of AI: you understand how modern AI tools and large language models work, and you have hands-on experience applying them to get real work done faster and better.
* You are an independent, critical thinker who challenges assumptions, makes sound decisions without needing step-by-step guidance, and drives outcomes from start to finish.
* You are comfortable working with ambiguity: when requirements are unclear or change quickly, you create structure, make progress on your own, and drive results without waiting for perfect information.
* You are driven to improve workstreams: you spot inefficiencies, rethink how things are done, and streamline or automate processes to make them scalable.
* You are available for a minimum of 4 months contract (preferred 6 months) & are based in Berlin.

**How we Upvest in you:**
=========================

* **Impact-driven work:** We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
* **Team celebrations:** Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
* **Inclusion**: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

**Our Values:**
===============

* **Make it easy for others.** We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.
* **Own the outcome.** We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
* **Rise to the challenge.** We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
* **Tell the story.** We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Business Analyst Intern (6 months) - 2027
description: There's a universe of opportunity at Amazon. At Amazon, your career doesn't follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you're part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You'll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You'll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you'll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn't know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure? What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. Key job responsibilities You will test your analytical and technical skills. This internship is a learning opportunity, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own growth in the Business Analysis function, as well as the team and our customers' success. Partner with multiple teams across different geographies, building collaborative relationships while learning from experienced professionals in a global business environment. Take ownership of data analysis projects with guidance from mentors, turning data insights into actionable business recommendations. Identify and propose process improvement opportunities, working with the team to develop streamlined solutions that enhance business efficiency. Lead root cause analyses for assigned projects, collaborating with team members to solve real business challenges and implement solutions. Support the development of business cases for new programs, gaining hands-on experience in strategic planning and project development. Own the maintenance and improvement of specific performance metrics dashboards, while learning advanced visualization techniques from experienced analysts. Develop into a valued team member by bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas, while building foundation skills in business analysis. A day in the life Location: Berlin Start Date: Flexible between January - March 2027. We don't offer 2026 start dates. Duration: 6 months minimum This is not a remote internship opportunity Every day is different as a Business Analyst Intern. You'll work alongside experienced analysts and a dedicated mentor on real data analysis projects that directly impact business efficiency. title: Founder's Associate Intern - Business Operations (m/w/d)
description: DU FÜHRST DAS GELD DIESER FIRMA. Jede Wärmepumpe, die wir einbauen, sind 35.000 bis 40.000 Euro. Auftragsbestätigung, Rechnung, Mahnung – läuft alles über deinen Schreibtisch. Ab Woche eins. Heizmüller baut Wärmepumpen in Berliner Altbauten. 24 Anlagen im Monat. Im ersten Jahr von null auf 1,2 Mio. Euro Monatsumsatz. Bootstrapped. Kein Investorengeld, das Fehler zudeckt. Büro in Alt-Moabit. Aufgaben Jeden Tag: Auftragsbestätigungen für die Verträge von gestern raus. Ohne Ausnahme – daran hängt der ganze Bau Eingangsrechnungen erfassen und dem Bauvorhaben zuordnen, Belege für den BuchhaltungsButler fertig machen Rückfragen aus dem Steuerbüro am selben Tag beantworten Mail und Telefon durchgehen, jedes Anliegen an Sales, Dispo, Bau oder Service zuordnen Jede Woche: Offene Posten. Wer hat nicht gezahlt, wer bekommt eine Mahnung. Fristen in der Förderung. Welche Baustelle ist abgenommen und noch nicht schlussgerechnet Jeden Monat: Monatsabschluss vorbereiten, Lohn mit dem Steuerbüro abstimmen. Und eine Sache abschaffen, die sich jeden Monat wiederholt hat – nicht schneller machen, abschaffen Woran wir messen: Kein Bauvorhaben startet ohne Auftragsbestätigung, keines endet ohne Schlussrechnung. Die überfällige Summe sinkt, weil du mahnst, bevor jemand fragt. Keine Förderfrist verstrichen Qualifikation Du studierst an einer renommierten Universität oder hast gerade abgeschlossen. Welches Fach, ist zweitrangig Du bist hypermotiviert und willst in kurzer Zeit viel lernen. Ein Praktikum, in dem man zusieht, wäre für dich verschwendete Zeit Du hast neben dem Studium schon etwas auf die Beine gestellt: ein eigenes Projekt, eine studentische Initiative, eine Werkstudentenstelle in einem schnellen Umfeld Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Sheets und hast schon in einem System gearbeitet, in dem Datensätze zusammenhängen: Airtable, ein CRM, ein ERP Genauigkeit ist bei dir Gewohnheit, nicht Vorsatz. Du merkst, wenn eine Summe nicht aufgeht Du schreibst fehlerfreies Deutsch. Mahnungen, Auftragsbestätigungen und Förderanträge gehen mit unserem Namen raus Buchhaltung musst du nicht können. Das lernst du hier Benefits Bis zu 3.500 Euro im Monat Option auf Übernahme als Full-Time Founder's Associate Büro in Alt-Moabit, Essen, keine Titel, kurze Wege zu den Gründern Den Einblick, den kein VC-Praktikum liefert: woran Firmen wirklich scheitern. Nicht am Produkt, am Geld Was du vorher wissen musst: Ab Woche eins fasst du echtes Geld an. Unser Chief of Staff liest die ersten Wochen gegen, danach nicht mehr. Niemand arbeitet dich ein – es gibt keine Anleitung, du schreibst sie. Alt-Moabit, jeden Tag, kein Home Office. Samstag im Office ist normal. Wenn du bei diesen Punkten innerlich abwinkst: gut. Dann sparen wir uns beide den Anruf. So läuft die Bewerbung: 1. Telefonat mit Linus, 20 Minuten. 2. Videogespräch mit Case und Rollenspiel. 3. Ein Termin bei uns im Büro, zwei Interviewer. 4. Eine Referenz, dann das Angebot. Kein Anschreiben. Lebenslauf reicht.

title: Venture Develoment Intern (d/f/m)
description: Our Story Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. Now, we are looking to build our next major growth engine. We are looking for an entrepreneurial Venture Development Intern to join the Office of the COO . You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up. Think of this as a founder’s associate role for an internal startup: you will turn an ambiguous opportunity into actionable hypotheses, run experiments and help build the business case for launch. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action. Duration: Fixed-term, full-time internship for a minimum of 3 months and up to 6 months. What you will do Discover and validate: Research markets and competitors, speak with potential customers and design experiments to test customer needs, demand and key assumptions. Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale. Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams. Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities. Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board. Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed. Academic collaboration If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements. Who you are Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook. AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer. Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning. Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story. Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model. Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English. Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment. What we offer C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making. Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process. Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building. A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors. An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup. If you are excited to combine structured thinking, AI tools and a founder’s mindset to help build what comes next at Taxfix, we would love to hear from you. Why Taxfix? A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office. Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture. At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves. Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - eCommerce (Internship) (m/w/d)
description: Was solltest du über uns wissen? Felmo macht Tiergesundheit so fürsorglich, vertrauenswürdig und bequem, wie sie sein sollte. Unsere angestellten Tierärzt:innen behandeln Hunde und Katzen dort, wo sie sich am wohlsten fühlen: zu Hause. Ergänzt wird unser Angebot durch eigene stationäre Tierarztpraxen. sowie unseren Online-Shop mit felmo Tiergesundheitsprodukten. Unser Online-Shop und unsere eigenen Tiergesundheitsprodukte ergänzen dieses Angebot und machen passende Produkte für Tierhalter:innen auch über den Tierarztbesuch hinaus zugänglich. Wir verbinden moderne Tiermedizin mit einem digitalen, kundenorientierten Ansatz. Deine Mission Als Entrepreneur in Residence - eCommerce Intern (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, das eCommerce-Geschäft von felmo weiterzuentwickeln und neue Wachstumspotenziale zu erschließen. Du arbeitest im eCommerce-Team und eng mit anderen Abteilungen bei felmo und dem Management Team zusammen. Dabei unterstützt du uns nicht nur bei Analysen, sondern verantwortet konkret eigene Projekte.. Deine Aufgaben: eCommerce Growth: Du unterstützt dabei, neue Wachstumspotenziale für unseren Online-Shop zu identifizieren und Ideen zur Umsatzsteigerung zu entwickeln. Shop Experience & Conversion Optimization: Du analysierst unseren Online-Shop inklusive der gesamten Customer Journey und hilfst dabei, das Einkaufserlebnis und damit die Conversion Rate zu verbessern. Business Analytics: Du wertest relevante eCommerce-Kennzahlen aus, beobachtest die Entwicklung unseres Shops und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Product & Market Research: Du analysierst Markttrends, Wettbewerber und Kundenbedürfnisse und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktangebots. Das bringst du mit Dein Studium: Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Management oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast mindestens 3 Fachsemester erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem Startup oder Scaleup gesammelt, idealerweise durch mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum in anspruchsvollen Bereichen. Erfahrungen im eCommerce, Venture Capital oder in der Strategieberatung sind von Vorteil. Nice to have: Du hast bereits eigene Projekte umgesetzt, erste Erfahrungen mit einem Online-Shop gesammelt oder bereits mit eCommerce-Tools wie Shopify oder Google Analytics gearbeitet. Kundenorientierung: Du denkst vom Kunden aus und leitest davon Potentiale für das Business ab. Du hast die Bedürfnisse des Kunden immer im Blick. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest strukturiert, bist zahlenaffin und hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Excel oder Google Sheets gesammelt. Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungsstärke: Du bist neugierig, lernst schnell, arbeitest selbstständig und hast Lust, Dinge nicht nur zu analysieren, sondern auch umzusetzen. Kommunikation: Du kannst dich in Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut verständigen und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Du hast kein Problem damit auf andere Abteilungen zuzugehen und Probleme über Teams hinweg zu lösen Das bieten wir dir Entrepreneurship hautnah: Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in den Aufbau und die Skalierung unseres eCommerce Geschäfts. Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an relevanten eCommerce Projekten mit und kannst erste eigene Themen übernehmen – mit Unterstützung unseres Teams. Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen aus eCommerce und Growth und erhältst Einblicke in unternehmerische Entscheidungen. Hoher Anspruch: Du gehst Aufgaben strukturiert an, bringst durchdachte Ideen ein und arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team an konkreten Ergebnissen. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Tools und der Anspruch, KI aktiv in deiner Arbeit einzusetzen. Team & Kultur: Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein offenes, kollaboratives Arbeitsumfeld. Über uns At felmo, we believe that pets deserve better care and a great quality of life. We work every day to provide our customers with the best possible pet health experience - online and offline - and use technology to spear-head digital pet health innovation worldwide. The one thing we love as much as our customers and pets is our employees and we work hard to create the best place to work in the pet health space and beyond. By doing so we are on a good path to become the world’s largest and most beloved pet health brand. Join us on our mission and change a whole industry for the better.

title: Junior Sales Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world's leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the **FinTech** connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers **better interest rates** and banks a **diversified form of refinancing**. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from **more than one million investors** which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

**Team**

The Business Development team at Raisin is constantly on the hunt for new partnership opportunities with banks across Europe. Our team, comprising Regional Sales Directors and Sales Operations, works collaboratively to identify and analyze high-value potential clients, optimize the sales pipeline, and seamlessly bring financial partners live onto Raisin's platforms. As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will serve as the engine of the sales organization: supporting deal execution, automating workflows, and assisting in the deployment and adoption of cutting-edge AI tools to continuously empower our team and scale our regional growth.

**Your Responsibilities**

As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will play a key role in empowering our Business Development team to build and scale partner bank relationships across Europe. Sitting at the intersection of sales, analytics, and strategy, you will help streamline our sales processes, maintain CRM hygiene, generate insights to optimize partner acquisition, and ensure smooth operational execution as prospective banking partners progress from initial contact to going live on the Raisin platform.

**Sales Process & Pipeline Management:**

* Support Regional Sales Directors by maintaining and optimizing the sales pipeline within the CRM .
* Ensure accurate tracking of deal stages, bank onboardings, and key milestones from initial outreach through contract signing to technical launch.
* Monitor and report on core sales KPIs, conversion metrics, and regional deal progress.

**AI Implementation & Workflow Automation:**

* Assist in identifying opportunities across the sales lifecycle to leverage AI and automation tools (e.g., AI call debriefs, automated email drafting, predictive lead scoring, automated CRM entry).
* Build, test, and roll out automated workflows to streamline administrative tasks for Regional Sales Directors and improve deal velocity.
* Train and support the sales team on adopting our AI tools and best practices, driving continuous team enablement and efficiency gains.

**Data Analysis & Reporting:**

* Collect, structure, and analyze commercial and operational data to evaluate potential bank partnership opportunities.
* Prepare regular reporting dashboards, pipeline performance reviews, and market/competitor analyses for sales leaders and management.

**Cross-Functional Operations & Enablement:**

* Coordinate with internal teams including Legal, Compliance, Product, and Integration Engineering to streamline the onboarding process for new bank partners.
* Help create, maintain, and update sales collateral, onboarding checklists, training materials, and process documentation.
* Assist in managing sales tools, ensuring seamless integrations and optimal usage across the sales team.

**Your Profile**

**Education & Experience:**

* Master/ Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Development, Commercial Operations, or Management Consulting is a plus (internships and working student roles in fast-paced FinTech/B2B Tech environments qualify).

**Technical & Analytical Skills:**

* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and office tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides).
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive presentations.
* Basic familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) is a plus.
* Previous experience with Google Scripts is a plus.

**Soft Skills & Mindset:**

* Excellent organizational skills, detail orientation, and ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-moving environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams.
* Proactive, hands-on, problem-solving attitude with a genuine interest in FinTech and B2B banking partnerships.

**Languages:**

* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.
* Additional European languages are a strong plus.

**Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!**

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

* Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
* Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
* A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
* Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
* Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
* Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
* Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
* You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

*Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy*

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Junior Project Manager – Premium Clients & AI Solutions (w/m/d)
description: Key Accounts, Projektmanagement und KI in einer Rolle. Deine Arbeit beginnt schon, bevor ein Konzern bei Everphone unterschreibt: Gemeinsam mit Sales entwickelst du die passende Lösung. Danach planst und steuerst du komplexe Roll-outs, führst deine Kunden durch das Onboarding und betreust sie als Key Account Manager langfristig. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du unsere wichtigsten Enterprise-Kunden: internationale Unternehmen mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, die teils zehntausende Geräte bei uns beziehen. Für sie bist du das Gesicht von Everphone und die Schnittstelle zu IT, Logistik, Procurement und Product. Und du gehst noch einen Schritt weiter, denn bei uns ist KI fester Teil der Arbeit. Du analysierst, wie Enterprise-Projekte heute gemanagt werden, und entwickelst sie mit eigenen Tools und Automatisierungen weiter. Du automatisierst Routine, treibst die Effizienz voran und hebst das Kundenerlebnis auf ein Level, das man aus klassischer Betreuung nicht kennt: individueller, schneller und mit Lösungen, die deine Kunden sonst nirgends bekommen. Was du heute baust, rollst du morgen bei deinen Kunden und im Team aus. Deine Aufgaben Vom Deal zum Roll-out Solution Design: Schon vor Vertragsabschluss entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Sales die passende Lösung für den Kunden. Roll-out-Projekte: Du planst und steuerst Roll-outs über drei bis zwölf Monate. Dazu gehören Projektplan, Prozesse, SLAs und Schulungen für die Ansprechpartner:innen in IT und HR. Onboarding: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson beim Onboarding unserer Geräte und Services und führst deine Kunden strukturiert durch alle Projektphasen. Key Account Management Accounts betreuen: Du führst regelmäßige Health Checks durch, löst Eskalationen und steuerst Backend- und IT-Projekte mit deinen Kunden. Accounts ausbauen: Du begleitest deine Kunden beim Wachstum, zum Beispiel in neue Länder. Du erkennst Potenziale und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit Sales weiter. Kundenstimme im Produkt: Du bringst Kundenbedürfnisse gezielt in die Produktentwicklung ein und entwickelst unseren Service aus Kundenperspektive weiter. KI und Automatisierung Aufgaben neu denken: Du hinterfragst, wie wir Projekte und Kunden heute betreuen, und findest Wege, es mit KI besser zu machen. Lösungen bauen: Per Vibe Coding entwickelst du eigene Apps, Tools und Automatisierungen für dich, für das Team und für deine Kunden. Team mitnehmen: Was funktioniert, teilst du, damit das ganze Team davon profitiert. Was Everphone dir bietet KI ist bei uns Arbeitsalltag KI-Tools ab Tag eins: Moderne KI-Tools stehen allen Rollen zur Verfügung, nicht nur dem Tech-Team Gestaltungsspielraum: Du darfst Prozesse hinterfragen und mit KI neu bauen. Eigene Automatisierungen und Tools sind ausdrücklich erwünscht Voneinander lernen: Kolleg:innen teilen offen, wie sie ihre Arbeit mit KI neu aufgebaut haben, und du lernst direkt aus der Praxis Zeit & Flexibilität Hybrides Arbeiten & Workation: Eine Mischung aus Office und Homeoffice, dazu bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland Urlaub: 30 Tage pro Jahr Dein Setup: Laptop und Smartphone deiner Wahl. Wir sind schließlich Device-as-a-Service Finanzen & Gesundheit Finanzielle Extras: Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, bis zu 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat und 348 € ÖPNV-Zuschuss pro Jahr Essenszuschuss: Wir bezuschussen dein Mittagessen, einfach Beleg per App hochladen Gesundheit: Bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft und kostenfreie, vertrauliche mentale Unterstützung über Voiio Gemeinschaft Im Office: Wöchentliche bezahlte Company Lunches und Frühstücks-Events, frisches Obst, Snacks und Kaffeespezialitäten. Und dein Hund ist auch willkommen Sprachen: Vollständig finanzierte Deutsch- und Englischkurse, damit sich im internationalen Team alle gut verstehen Community: Sommer- und Winterfest sowie Employee Resource Groups, in denen du dich vernetzen und einbringen kannst Das bringst du mit Must-haves Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel in BWL, VWL oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, B2B-Kundenbetreuung oder Beratung mit, gern auch als Werkstudent:in. Bauen mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder Gemini täglich und hast per Vibe Coding (zum Beispiel mit Claude Code) schon eigene Apps, Tools oder Automatisierungen gebaut, die tatsächlich genutzt werden, beruflich oder privat. Prozessverständnis: Du durchschaust komplexe Abläufe, Systeme und Kundenstrukturen schnell und erkennst sofort, wo Optimierungspotenzial liegt und was sich automatisieren lässt. Excel und Google Sheets: Du arbeitest sicher mit großen Datensätzen und wendest Pivot-Tabellen, SVERWEIS und XVERWEIS routiniert an. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du erkennst Muster und Zusammenhänge in Daten und leitest daraus fundierte Entscheidungen ab. Organisationsfähigkeit: Du strukturierst Projekte mit vielen Beteiligten, setzt klare Prioritäten und behältst mehrere Kunden parallel im Blick. Stakeholder-Management: Du bringst unterschiedliche Interessen von Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und findest auch in kritischen Situationen schnell eine Lösung, die alle mittragen. Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst klar und auf den Punkt, präsentierst überzeugend und stellst dich sicher auf dein Gegenüber ein, vom Fachbereich bis zur Managementebene. Das alles auf Deutsch und Englisch, jeweils mindestens C1. Belastbarkeit: Anspruchsvolle Kunden, wechselnde Prioritäten und Phasen mit hohem Druck bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Wenn es darauf ankommt, gehst du die Extra-Meile. Eigeninitiative: Du suchst nicht nach Aufgaben, du findest sie. Nice-to-haves Vertriebliches Gespür: Du erkennst Potenziale in deinen Accounts und hast ein Gefühl für vertriebliche Chancen. Roll-out-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Roll-outs, Logistik- oder IT-Hardware-Projekte begleitet. Weitere Sprachen: Du sprichst Französisch oder Italienisch.

title: Junior Affiliate Operations & Technical Specialist (f/m/x) - Fashion & Luxury
description:
***Position:*** *Junior Affiliate Operations & Technical Specialist*

***Location:*** *Berlin*

***Job Type:*** *Full-time*

Our agency Claudia Wünsch Communication specialises in online marketing and communication for the fashion, luxury and lifestyle industry.

We are looking for a Junior Affiliate Operations & Technical Specialist to support all client accounts with platform administration, product feeds and day-to-day technical tasks.

Working with experienced colleagues, you will learn our platforms and processes, handle routine tasks and help investigate issues. You will receive training and guidance, taking on more responsibility as your skills develop.

**Responsibilities:**

**Platform Operations:** Support programme settings, publisher configurations and support requests in Partnerize, Rakuten Advertising, impact.com and Awin, following team guidance.

**Commissions and Promotions:** Help set up approved commission rates, publisher incentives and promotions; check markets, eligibility and dates with an experienced colleague.

**Tracking and Troubleshooting:** Check affiliate links, carry out guided test purchases and collect information on missing transactions or tracking issues for investigation and escalation.

**Product Feed Management:** Support feed maintenance in Channable; check prices, stock, images, categories and URLs, and help update mappings and rules with guidance

**Creative Assets and Links:** Upload banners, create text links and deep links, update campaign assets and remove expired materials in line with brand guidelines.

**Publisher Support:** Answer routine questions about links, assets and programme access; follow up with platform support and escalate complex issues to experienced colleagues.

**Launches and Programme Changes:** Assist with onboarding, programme updates and migrations by completing checklists, checking settings and documenting test results.

**Quality Assurance:** Check your work, keep task records and guides up to date, and flag errors or competing deadlines to the account team.

**Qualifications:**

Some practical exposure to affiliate operations or similar digital marketing tasks, gained through an internship, working student role, project or previous job. No minimum number of years is required.

Initial familiarity with an affiliate platform, tracking links, campaign settings or product feeds. Experience with every platform we use is not required.

Interest in product data and technical troubleshooting. Channable or comparable feed tool experience is welcome; training will be provided.

A basic understanding of affiliate marketing and a willingness to learn how tracking, commissions and product feeds work.

Confidence using Excel or spreadsheets, attention to detail and an organised approach to tasks and deadlines.

Clear communication, a collaborative attitude and confidence asking for help; fluency in English, with German and/or Italian a plus.

Interest in fashion and luxury, curiosity about technical processes and motivation to develop practical affiliate operations skills.

**We offer you:**

Practical training in affiliate platforms, Channable and tracking checks, with guidance from experienced colleagues and increasing responsibility.

A central and attractive location in a modern office in Berlin

Exciting projects with renowned customers in the luxury and fashion sectors

Public transport ticket grant

Flexible work environment with options for remote work.

Fruits, snacks and one weekly meal

Would you like to become part of Claudia Wünsch Communication? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents, including the earliest possible starting date, which you can send online to **personal@claudia-wuensch.com**

Gehalt: 31.500,00€ - 60.000,00€ pro Jahr

Leistungen:

* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

Arbeitsort: Vor Ort

title: (Associate) Product Manager- Settlement Services (m/f/x)
description: Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform. Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services. Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say. Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English). Job Description We are looking for a curious and motivated (Associate) Product Manager (m/f/x) to join our clearing, settlement, and custody team. In this role, you will help shape complex post-trade journeys – including securities transfers and workflows around Germany’s new Altersvorsorgedepot . Working closely with experienced Product Managers, you will learn how to make financial infrastructure fast, reliable, and intuitive while balancing client needs with operational and regulatory requirements. Operating at the intersection of technology, finance, and operations, you will collaborate daily with Software Engineers, Operations, Client Service, Compliance, as well as external settlement partners and central securities depositories (CSDs) to build scalable solutions for millions of clients. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the product roadmap: Support in defining, prioritizing, and executing the roadmap for our clearing, settlement, and custody capabilities, gradually taking ownership of your own defined product areas. Drive feature delivery: Work closely with Engineering, Operations, Client Service, and Compliance to take product features from discovery and specification through launch and iteration. Turn insights into user stories: Analyze product data, market trends, and client feedback to write clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that create seamless user journeys. Coordinate with external partners: Collaborate with settlement counterparties, central securities depositories (CSDs), and infrastructure partners to ensure smooth integrations and workflows. Qualifications First practical experience: Initial experience in product management, consulting, project management, or a tech/fintech start-up (including relevant internships or working student roles). Academic background: A degree in Management, Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Analytical mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with enthusiasm for using data and user feedback to guide product decisions. Structured & detail-oriented: A hands-on, organized working style with high attention to detail – essential when dealing with financial transactions and regulatory topics. Customer focus: Empathy for user needs and the drive to simplify complex financial processes. Communication: Clear and concise communication skills in English; fluency or working proficiency in German is a strong plus. Bonus: Any prior exposure to financial markets, banking/fintech, securities transfers, or regulated environments. Additional Information Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients Work from our centrally located offices in the heart of Munich or Berlin, nestled in lively neighborhoods filled with vibrant restaurants, cozy cafés, and a wide range of convenient amenities Be productive with the latest hardware and tools Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes International relocation support is provided if required Opportunity to work from abroad Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’ Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description: Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht. Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet. Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen. Was du bei uns machst Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen. Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen. Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich. Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design. Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind – und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben. Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt. KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss. Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss. Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe. Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen. Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus. Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung. Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran. Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein – wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe. Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen. Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. Deine Benefits Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro. Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget. Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr. Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir. Du willst komplexe Abläufe verstehen und daraus ein Produkt machen, das Menschen gerne nutzen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

title: Working Student - Technical Equipment Coordinator (m/f/d)
description:
Requisition Number: 80040

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Your Responsibilities:**
--------------------------

**Management and Maintenance of Test Equipment:**

* + Ensure the availability and functionality of test equipment.
  + Organize calibrations, repairs, and regular maintenance.
  + Create and maintain an inventory of test equipment.

**Shipping of Test Equipment and Product Samples:**

* + Coordinate the shipment of test equipment and product samples to internal and external partners.
  + Monitor returns and perform condition checks.
  + Ensure timely delivery and proper documentation.

**Building and Evaluating Prototype Setups:**

* + Assemble and mock-up samples, in the area of structured fiber optic cabling.
  + Evaluate the feasibility of new designs and assess the functionality of existing products in new applications.
  + Provide detailed feedback and recommendations for improvements.
  + Work closely with the Engineering Services team to refine product handling methods and procedures.

**General Administrative Tasks for the Team:**

* + Support the team with organizational and administrative tasks (e.g., scheduling, documentation, minute-taking).
  + Manage material orders and resources.
  + Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

**Your Profile:**
-----------------

  

* Studying a technical field, preferably with experience in test equipment and practical cabling installation.
* Familiarity installation processes, test equipment, sample mockups.
* Structured and independent working style with excellent organizational skills.
* Strong communication abilities and a team-oriented mindset.
* Proficient in MS Office; experience with ERP and/or inventory management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal proficiency in both German and English.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

  

* An exciting position in an innovative and growing company.
* An international and dynamic work environment within the EMEA region.
* Attractive working conditions and development opportunities.
* The chance to actively contribute to improving processes, workflows, and safety standards.

If this description resonates with you and you’re interested in a diverse role within the telecommunications and data center infrastructure industry, we look forward to receiving your application!
